description.value: The YMCA/YWCA Westhills is a full-service recreation and community centre operated by the YMCA-YWCA of Vancouver Island in the Westhills area of Langford. The facility offers fitness, aquatics (pool), child care, and community health programming as part of a well-established non-profit network with locations across Greater Victoria. Touring cyclists would find it a potentially useful services stop, though most amenities are oriented toward members and registered participants.

No page-specific amenity details (bike parking, showers, water refill) are presented in the fetched content for the Westhills branch specifically. The organization phone 250-386-7511 appears on the website front page but is likely a centralized number for the Downtown Victoria location, not Westhills.
